question: A starts a business with ₹75,000 and B joins the business 5 months later with an investment of ₹80,000. After 1 year, they earn a profit of ₹4,08,800. Find the share of A and B (in ₹).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Profit Ratio = (CapitalA × TimeA) : (CapitalB × TimeB)

Ratio = (75 × 12) : (80 × 7) = 900 : 560 = 45 : 28

Total Ratio = 45 + 28 = 73 units

73 units = ₹4,08,800 ⇒ 1 unit = ₹5,600

A’s share = 45 × 5,600 = ₹2,52,000

B’s share = 28 × 5,600 = ₹1,56,800

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2,52,000 and ₹1,56,800.**
